title: Tag entries with their source
description: Stages, for many lexical entries at once, the Attribution tag <source>@<revision> <licence> in each entry's Bibliography, written after any Bibliography text already there. An entry that already carries the tag stages nothing, so the command is safe to run again. Give one intent with many entries, or --entries-file and --tag; only a person can Apply.
usage: Usage: motif compose-set-entry-attribution --draft <name> --project <fwdata> --intent '<closed intent JSON>', or --entries-file <file> --tag '<source>@<revision> <licence>' [--analysis-ws <tag>] in place of --intent [--json] [--cite-source <text> [--cite-locator <text>]]
